title: Changing Sales Type on Sales By Customer collapses rows and survives Back
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Today {Customer-A} has an invoiced part sale and an invoiced work order.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Customer is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand {Customer-A}'s row.
  2. Select only "Service Sales".
  3. Expand {Customer-A} again and open the work order's invoice from it.
  4. Press the browser's back button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row expands.
  • Step 2: every expanded row collapses and {Customer-A} shows only the work order's figures.
  • Step 3: the invoice opens.
  • Step 4: the report returns with "Sales Type: Service Sales" still selected.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: "SBC (Sales By Customer) Report" spec, Confluence 577634305, version 21 (6 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Sales By Customer spec, S8-R20: “Any change that re-fetches customer rows from the server — the date range, Sales Type, location, the Customer filter, or the sort — collapses all expanded rows.”
  • Sales By Customer spec, S9-R3: “Before navigating, the active date range and Sales Type are written to the page link so the report can be restored.”
